**Stable ID:** `DATA-01.04` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 01 Scope, taxonomy and governance

Establish who proposes, reviews, accepts and publishes dataset research, and how decisions and escalations are recorded.

## Deliverables

- Role matrix linked to organization team policy
- Decision-register format and escalation path

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/charter.md`
- `planning/decision-register.json`
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Role matrix cites the organization CONTRIBUTING.md revision it implements

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each decision type names its proposer, reviewer and approver roles
- [ ] Independent review cannot be satisfied by the author or a bot
- [ ] Decision register validates in CI

## Non-goals

- Changing organization team membership
- Granting access to individuals

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-01.04.T1` Define roles
  - [ ] `DATA-01.04.T1.S1` Map contributor, reviewer and maintainer roles to organization teams
  - [ ] `DATA-01.04.T1.S2` Define the independent-review rule
  - [ ] `DATA-01.04.T1.S3` Define emergency and bypass handling
- [ ] `DATA-01.04.T2` Define the decision record
  - [ ] `DATA-01.04.T2.S1` Specify decision-register fields
  - [ ] `DATA-01.04.T2.S2` Seed the register with foundation decisions
  - [ ] `DATA-01.04.T2.S3` Validate the register in CI

## Dependencies

- No prerequisite work packages.
- Blocks `DATA-02.01`, `DATA-12.01`

## Review requirements

- Research lead maintainer
- Approval must come from someone other than the author of the change and must cover the latest push.

## Cross-repository handoffs

- None.
